title: Make Cyclotron persistence portable across SQLite and DynamoDB
description: Ryan explicitly selected full cloud-native storage portability and rejected server-hosted SQLite. This supersedes checkpoint-only design. Preserve complete zero-cloud local SQLite behavior and Python/API/UI. Inventory every catalog/item/label/explanation/prediction/cycle/history/learning/job/lease/cache/session path. Shared backend contract, native SQLite parity, immutable S3 payloads and rebuildable DynamoDB index. Cloud coordination authority is undecided: approving a DDB index does NOT approve authoritative DDB CAS/counters/claims. Compare bounded canonical S3 per-run CAS ledger with additional DDB transaction authority before implementing either coordinator. First cohesive slice: shared decision batches, durable paid-attempt ceiling, cache generations/history and restart; all remaining authoritative stores must convert before hosted cloud mode can be enabled. Contract tests: concurrency/idempotency/pagination/scoped isolation/recovery/migration fidelity. Existing console account integration decision-flywheel-73a50b5e-7f10-4908-aed5-45f87e02da28. Preserve priming branches, no Kanbus issue encoding or TypeScript rewrite. No EC2 SQLite host, cloud resources/IAM/OAuth/deploy/public push; Papyrus remote/embedded initiatives remain separate planning.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Design delivered in docs/optional-persistence-design.md. Inspected exact Virtuus PR33 f94d7e2 and Kanbus PR399 25410911 clean product worktrees. Recommend optional embedded checkpoint repository over existing Cyclotron snapshot/restore, preserving cloud-free SQLite/local worker; raw Virtuus ObjectStore semantics reusable but new store currently Rust-only, Python bridge ownership needs decision. DynamoDB catalog is rebuildable, not transactional runtime authority. Separate later WorkspaceRepository domain transactions and fenced durable runner; no Kanbus issue encoding. Existing embedded_store_test.py: 9 passed; prior account checkpoint: 73 focused Python +252 UI passed and synthetic browser proof. No adapter/hosting/resource/grant implementation. Await parent design decision before next implementation.

comments.author: home
comments.text: First implementation checkpoint: docs/storage-portability.md inventories all persistence and replaces checkpoint-only scope. Native BatchStorage + SQLite shared-request cache preserves legacy tables/raw payloads/history and now atomically reserves budget/generation, grants one dispatch claim, fences stale completion and exports/restores exact retained evidence. SharedDecisions consumes injected storage without issuing SQL. Immutable local/S3 payload adapters enforce scoped hashes, read bounds and create-only retry safety. Optional DynamoDB index is rebuildable discovery ONLY, verified from canonical bytes, with bounded additive rebuilds/pages; never mutable heads or paid coordination. 80 focused synthetic tests pass including separate-process dispatch/restart, concurrency, migration, scope/corruption/lost response and SDK serialization. Full Python regression running. IMPORTANT: authoritative DDB CAS/counters/claims are a distinct UNAPPROVED semantics choice; docs compare minimal S3 canonical per-run CAS ledger vs DDB transaction authority. No cloud coordinator silently introduced, no hosted mode enabled. All remaining catalog/runtime/learning/job/lease/session conversions remain open; no claim full conversion. Priming worktrees untouched. No AWS/IAM/OAuth/deploy/public push.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Final local validation: 1398 Python regression tests passed, 1 skipped (existing pytest-bdd deprecation warnings). Final focused set 82 passed, including added zero-AWS/network-forbidden default open/restart spec. Concurrent-refresh regression first reproduced mismatched payload/generation, fixed by a single SQLite statement snapshot; now passes. Full implementation checkpoint remains local/unpublished and story in progress: full cloud storage conversion, coordinator authority decision, IAM/OAuth and deployment remain outstanding. No cloud writes or priming changes. Parent direct thread messenger still returns thread not found; checkpoint also reported in commentary/final.
